topPRs.title: chore: add elizaos/cloud to tracked repos
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## Summary - Add `elizaos/cloud` repository (default branch: `dev`) to `PIPELINE_REPOS` in pipeline config ## Test plan - [ ] Verify pipeline ingestion picks up the new repo - [ ] Confirm leaderboard data includes cloud contributors

Greptile Summary

This PR adds `elizaos/cloud` (default branch `dev`) to the `PIPELINE_REPOS` list in `config/example.json`, which is the default pipeline configuration file used by CI/CD. The change is minimal and well-formed. Key observations: - The entry follows the same JSON structure as every other repo in `PIPELINE_REPOS`. - The `discoverUntrackedRepos` pipeline explicitly filters out any repo already listed in `PIPELINE_REPOS` (see `trackedRepos` set in `discoverUntrackedRepos.ts`), so `elizaos/cloud` will **not** be double-counted by the `PIPELINE_UNTRACKED_REPOS` auto-discovery scanner. - Using `"defaultBranch": "dev"` is intentional and consistent with the PR description; no other repos currently use a `dev` branch, but the pipeline config schema imposes no restrictions on branch names. - `elizaos-plugins/plugin-elizaos-cloud` is already tracked separately — the new entry is for the top-level `elizaos/cloud` repo, which is a distinct repository.

Confidence Score: 5/5

- This PR is safe to merge — it is a single-line, additive config change with no logic impact. - The change is purely additive, touches only the config file, follows the established entry format, and the pipeline correctly deduplicates against the untracked-repos scanner. No functional code is modified. - No files require special attention.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | config/example.json | Adds `{ "owner": "elizaos", "name": "cloud", "defaultBranch": "dev" }` to the `PIPELINE_REPOS` array; entry is well-formed and consistent with sibling entries. |

Flowchart

```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[pipeline.config.ts] -->|reads PIPELINE_CONFIG_FILE| B[config/example.json] B -->|PIPELINE_REPOS| C{discoverUntrackedRepos} B -->|PIPELINE_UNTRACKED_REPOS| C C -->|builds trackedRepos Set| D[elizaos/eliza\nelizaos/cloud ✅ NEW\nelizaos/elizaos.github.io\n...] C -->|scans orgs elizaos + elizaos-plugins| E[All org repos] E -->|filter: NOT in trackedRepos Set| F[Untracked repos only] D -->|explicitly tracked → full pipeline ingestion| G[Leaderboard / Contributor Data] F -->|auto-discovered repos| G ``` Last reviewed commit: f3037a5
